extName.description: Product name (manifest name, popup header, page titles). Do not translate.

extDescription.message: Synchro bidirectionnelle en direct entre la barre de formule Power Apps Studio et VS Code. Non officielle, non affiliée à Microsoft.
extDescription.description: Manifest description shown in the browser's extension list and store. Max 132 characters.

openPowerApps.description: Button/link that opens make.powerapps.com (popup and welcome page).

help.description: Footer link to the README (popup and welcome page).

reconnect.description: Button that retries the connection to VS Code.

popupStateConnecting.description: Popup status line while connecting to VS Code.

popupStateDisconnected.description: Popup status line when VS Code is not reachable.

popupSubNoStudio.message: Aucun onglet Power Apps Studio détecté
popupSubNoStudio.description: Popup status detail when no Studio tab is open.

popupSubLinked.description: Popup status detail when Studio is open and connected to VS Code.

popupSubDetected.description: Popup status detail when Studio is open but not connected to VS Code.

popupActiveFormula.description: Heading of the card showing the control and property currently being edited.

popupHintInstallAndOpen.message: Cette extension fonctionne avec l’extension « Power Apps X VS Code » pour VS Code : installe-la, puis ouvre une canvas app en modification dans Power Apps Studio.
popupHintInstallAndOpen.description: Popup hint when no Studio tab is open and VS Code has never answered.

popupHintOpenApp.message: Ouvre une canvas app en modification dans Power Apps Studio.
popupHintOpenApp.description: Popup hint when no Studio tab is open.

popupHintNoResponseInstall.message: VS Code ne répond pas. Installe l’extension « Power Apps X VS Code » dans VS Code et garde VS Code ouvert. À la première connexion, VS Code demande d’autoriser ce navigateur : accepte.
popupHintNoResponseInstall.description: Popup hint when Studio is open, VS Code is not reachable and has never answered.

popupHintNoResponsePort.message: VS Code ne répond pas sur le port $PORT$. Vérifie que VS Code est ouvert avec l’extension « Power Apps X VS Code » et le même port. Si VS Code demande d’autoriser ce navigateur, accepte.
popupHintNoResponsePort.description: Popup hint when Studio is open and VS Code, which answered before, is not reachable.

popupHintSelectControl.message: Sélectionne un contrôle dans Studio : sa formule s’ouvre dans VS Code.
popupHintSelectControl.description: Popup hint when connected but no control is selected.

popupInstallVs.description: Popup button that opens the welcome page.

popupPortLabel.description: Label of the port number field.

popupSaved.description: Save button text shown briefly after saving.

popupPortHelpBefore.description: Port help, text before the setting name powerappsBridge.port (a space is added after it).

popupPortHelpAfter.description: Port help, text after the setting name powerappsBridge.port (a space is added before it).

popupAnalyze.description: Button that runs the diagnostic on the active tab.

popupCopyResult.description: Button that copies the diagnostic output.

popupCopied.description: Copy button text shown briefly after copying.

popupDiagnosticResultAria.description: Accessible name of the diagnostic output text area.

popupAnalyzing.description: Shown in the diagnostic output while the analysis runs.

popupError.description: Diagnostic output when the analysis fails.
